Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "the ceramics delivery arrived at the side entrance just before ten on thursday and the driver left three boxes under the awning because the front steps were wet i counted the bowls and serving plates before signing and one small blue cup was missing the packing slip listed the actual cost of the delivery as 91.16 not 127.43 so i took a photo of it beside the boxes the driver said the missing cup might still be in the van but he could not check until he finished the next stop i called the shop after lunch and spoke with maren she asked me to email the photo and said she would compare the slip with the order i have sent the picture but i have not heard back yet the boxes are dry and the plates look intact though one bowl has a rough patch along the rim i am not sure whether that is part of the glaze or a flaw please keep the empty box until the shop replies because they may ask for the label i would like the cup sent separately if it was left behind and i am not asking for a refund at this point", "output": "The ceramics delivery arrived at the side entrance just before ten on Thursday, and the driver left three boxes under the awning because the front steps were wet. I counted the bowls and serving plates before signing, and one small blue cup was missing. The packing slip listed the actual cost of the delivery as 91.16 not 127.43, so I took a photo of it beside the boxes. The driver said the missing cup might still be in the van, but he could not check until he finished the next stop. I called the shop after lunch and spoke with Maren. She asked me to email the photo and said she would compare the slip with the order. I have sent the picture, but I have not heard back yet. The boxes are dry, and the plates look intact, though one bowl has a rough patch along the rim. I am not sure whether that is part of the glaze or a flaw. Please keep the empty box until the shop replies because they may ask for the label. I would like the cup sent separately if it was left behind, and I am not asking for a refund at this point."}]
